hooks.text: 厨师、裁缝和雕塑匠把职业手艺直接转化为不同战斗机制
hooks.excerpt: Select your Crafter Choose from a variety of crafters and artisans with their own unique set of skills and mechanics, for different gameplay experiences. Between cooking your enemies, sewing them together or building statues that will crush your foes, there will always be a crafty way to defend your home!
